strings.选择或拖入本地 DEB 软件包: Drop a DEB. We’ll take it from here.
strings.支持 Ubuntu / Debian 原生 .deb 安装包。载入后先查看元数据: Install local Ubuntu and Debian packages. Review package details and the APT plan before authorizing changes.
strings.将按上方计划安装，随后弹出系统授权窗口: Review the plan. Authorize through the system dialog.
strings.保留原文件 · 系统授权安装: Original files preserved · Authorized by your system
strings.软件包检查或安装过程中发生错误，请查看下方日志。: The operation failed. Check the logs below.
strings.系统授权未完成，请查看日志后重新检查。: Authorization was not completed. Review logs and check again.
Analyzing dependencies and the APT plan…
strings.尚未执行检查。请点击下方“检查安装计划”以分析依赖与计划变更。: Review the plan below to check dependencies and changes.
Checking dependencies and preparing the plan…
strings.选择一个或多个下载好的 DEB 文件。: Choose one or more local DEB files.
strings.当前任务尚未结束，请完成后再选择其他包。: Wait for the current task before choosing other packages.
strings.任务正在进行，请等待结果后关闭窗口。: Wait for the current task before closing this window.
strings.外观设置未能保存，请检查配置目录权限。: Could not save appearance. Check configuration directory permissions.
strings.语言设置未能保存，请检查配置目录权限。: Could not save language. Check configuration directory permissions.
strings.文件选择器未能完成，请重试。: The file picker could not complete. Please try again.
strings.操作未能完成，请查看详细日志。: The operation could not complete. Check detailed logs.
strings.软件包已就绪，请先检查安装计划。: Packages ready. Review the installation plan first.
strings.检查完成。请核对下方计划，确认后安装。: Review complete. Check the plan before confirming installation.
strings.所选版本已安装且无需更改，不必重复安装。: The selected versions are installed. No changes needed.
strings.正在检查依赖和安装计划……: Checking dependencies and the installation plan…
strings.安装完成，已核对软件包版本和配置状态。: Installation complete. Versions and configured status verified.
strings.正在核对计划，随后弹出系统授权窗口……: Verifying the plan before opening system authorization…
strings.正在安装软件包，可以展开日志查看详情。: Installing packages. Expand the logs for details.
strings.所选版本已安装，当前无需更改。: The selected versions are installed. No changes needed.
strings.完整检查输出可在详细日志中查看。: Full preflight output is available in detailed logs.
strings.请选择至少一个 DEB 文件。: Choose at least one DEB file.
strings.检查期间系统软件状态发生了变化，请重新检查。: Package state changed during review. Review the plan again.
strings.安装计划需要卸载现有软件，已中止。: The plan would remove existing packages. Installation blocked.
strings.请先检查安装计划，然后确认安装。: Review the installation plan before confirming installation.
strings.系统软件状态已发生变化，请重新检查安装计划。: System package state changed. Review the plan again.
strings.临时软件包内容发生变化，请重新选择文件。: The staged packages changed. Choose the files again.
strings.安装计划已变化或无法确认，请重新检查。: The plan changed or could not be verified. Review it again.
strings.系统授权未完成。软件可能尚未开始安装，请查看日志后重新检查。: System authorization was not completed. Installation may not have started. Review logs and check again.
strings.系统授权已完成，授权后的安装计划已核对。: System authorization complete. The plan was rechecked.
strings.从 GitHub 获取最新公开版本信息。: Check the latest public release on GitHub.
strings.无法连接 GitHub，请稍后重试。: Could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
strings.无法连接 GitHub，请检查网络后重试。: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
strings.发布版本信息无效，请稍后重试。: The release response was invalid. Try again later.
strings.无法打开浏览器，请手动访问项目发布页。: Could not open your browser. Visit the project release page manually.
strings.此设置只影响 Debloom。: These settings apply only to Debloom.

Installation did not complete (exit code $1). Check detailed logs; changes were not automatically rolled back.
